pages.text: Hold fine gold and right-click the $(item)Jeweler's Bench$(). Click when the marker is in the green, three times, to chase it into two $(item)Gold Fittings$() of its ★. A miss can spoil it back into nuggets.
pages.title: Chasing

pages.text: Fittings make $(item)Gold Rings$() (+1 max health a ★) and $(item)Gold Amulets$() (+0.5 armor a ★), worn in Curios' ring and necklace slots; and $(item)gilded$() armor and swords: lighter than plate, easy to enchant, and piglins take them for gold.
pages.title: Jewelry and Gilded Gear
